title: List all PCI devices on the computer
summary: Use lspci to see a quick overview of hardware components like graphics cards, network adapters, and sound cards connected to the PCI bus.

steps.explain: Run lspci to display a brief list of all PCI devices detected by the system.
steps.expect: A list of devices with their IDs and names, e.g., '00:02.0 VGA compatible controller: Intel Corporation...'
